_______________________________________

Scheduling with DRS has never been easier!

Just log into your MyDRS portal, and choose "appointments". Next scroll down and click "Request New Appointment". 

For more detailed instructions on how to use this new option, check out our new Scheduling Appointments FAQ page. 

If you don't see any availability, please make sure that you're searching at least 3 weeks out.
